visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Cached Zero Counts as Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Calling square(0) twice should compute only once (calls: 1), but it computes twice.

solution.explanation: The stored result for 0 is 0, which is falsy, so !cache[n] says "not cached" even though it is. Test whether the key exists with the in operator instead of testing whether the value is truthy.
